people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed down to the ground before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto Jehovah.
